The '''Lali system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Lali Plague]],<ref name="JQ">''[[Jedi Quest: The School of Fear]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Lali Plague]]|system=Lali [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> which had broken out at some point by [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Quest: The School of Fear]]'', in which the [[Lali Plague]] is mentioned, to [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Lali system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
